purpose: Durable owner feedback for reusable design experiments. Preferred means a visual direction to preserve, not a research-result claim or a finished site identity.

experiments.title: Green light and form
experiments.feedback: Accepted reference for light, silhouette, reveal, selective flash and pointer response.

experiments.title: Three directions
experiments.feedback: Interlocking blocks and proof branches preferred. Nested frames not the direction to pursue.

experiments.title: Electric magenta
experiments.feedback: Bright magenta with depth and pink-white peaks preferred over muted purple.

experiments.title: Branch claw extraction
experiments.feedback: The mechanism became overcrowded and too small. Keep it as history; simplify the main action.

experiments.title: Interlocking reveal
experiments.feedback: User authorized the three-piece prototype; no explicit final verdict recorded.

experiments.title: Illustrative proof branches
experiments.feedback: On 3 November the owner called this really good and asked to keep exploring and record what works. Preserve this interaction as a preferred baseline.

experiments.title: Results and evidence
experiments.feedback: User requested a separate real-data comparison. Research interpretation comes from the public feeds, independently of the visual verdict.

experiments.title: Evidence constellation
experiments.feedback: Owner requested a much more adventurous visual experiment. This separate sculpture adds burst/snap choreography, filaments and direct record pulling; the new result awaits review.
